# ☀️ Gud Mornin Landing Page

💼 **Commercial Project**

🔗 Live Demo: https://pashko911.github.io/gud_mornin

---

## ✨ About

**Gud Mornin** is a promotional landing page for a meme token project built around positive vibes, friendship, and the joy of every new day.

The website introduces the concept of the token, provides tokenomics details, explains how to buy $gm, and encourages users to join the community.

The design focuses on a playful, animated experience with a strong visual identity inspired by meme culture and morning aesthetics.

---

## 🚀 Features

- 🎨 Custom UI/UX design with a unique visual style
- 🧩 Modular and scalable structure (BEM methodology)
- 📱 Fully responsive layout (mobile-first approach)
- ⚡ Optimized performance (PageSpeed 90+)
- 🎞️ Rich animations and interactive elements
- 🌀 Smooth scrolling powered by Lenis
- 🎯 Scroll-based navigation (data-goto system)
- 📊 Tokenomics section with visual storytelling
- 🛒 Step-by-step “How to Buy”
- 🔗 Social integrations (Telegram, X, Dexscreener, Dextools)
- 📋 Copy-to-clipboard functionality (contract address)

---

## 🛠️ Technologies Used

- HTML5
- SCSS (Sass)
- JavaScript (ES6+)
- Gulp (build system)
- Swiper.js (slider)
- Lenis (smooth scrolling)
